nodes.name: Local leaves: procedure
nodes.statement:
Similarly to the global theorem verification after the steps 1. and 2. above, we perform the following steps for each row with nodeType=2:

    \begin{enumerate}
    \setcounter{enumi}{2}
    \item Check that $P_1,P_2,P_3$ and $Q_1,Q_2,Q_3$ are congruent by applying \cref{lem:congruent} (verifying that $P^tP = Q^tQ$ and $\det(Q) \neq 0$).
    \item Compute $\overline{M_1}$, $\overline{M_2} \in \mathbb{Q}^{2 \times 3}$, $\overline{X_1}, \overline{X_2} \in \mathbb{Q}^{3}$ and $R_{\mathbb{Q}}(\overline{\alpha}) \in \mathbb{Q}^{2 \times 2}$ as in \cref{thm:global_rational}.
    \item Set $\sigma_Q =$ sigma\_Q and check that 
    \[
        \langle \overline{X_1}, \widetilde{P}_i\rangle>\sqrt{2}\varepsilon + 3 \kappa \quad \text{ and } \quad (-1)^{\sigma_Q} \langle \overline{X_2},\widetilde{P}_i\rangle>\sqrt{2}\varepsilon +3 \kappa.
    \]
    \item Check that $\widetilde{P}_1,\widetilde{P}_2,\widetilde{P}_3$ are $\varepsilon$-$\kappa$-spanning for $(\overline{\theta}_1, \overline{\varphi}_1)$ and that $\widetilde{Q}_1,\widetilde{Q}_2,\widetilde{Q}_3$ are $\varepsilon$-$\kappa$-spanning for $(\overline{\theta}_2, \overline{\varphi}_2)$ by verifying the inequalities in \cref{def:ekspanning}:
        \begin{align*}
                \langle R(\pi/2) \overline{M_1} \widetilde{P}_1, \overline{M_1} \widetilde{P}_{2}\rangle > 2 \varepsilon(\sqrt{2} + \varepsilon) + 6\kappa,\\
                \langle R(\pi/2) \overline{M_1} \widetilde{P}_2, \overline{M_1} \widetilde{P}_{3}\rangle > 2 \varepsilon(\sqrt{2} + \varepsilon) + 6\kappa,\\
                \langle R(\pi/2) \overline{M_1} \widetilde{P}_3, \overline{M_1} \widetilde{P}_{1}\rangle > 2 \varepsilon(\sqrt{2} + \varepsilon) + 6\kappa,
        \end{align*}
        and 
            \begin{align*}
                \langle R(\pi/2) \overline{M_2} \widetilde{Q}_1, \overline{M_2} \widetilde{Q}_{2}\rangle > 2 \varepsilon(\sqrt{2} + \varepsilon) + 6\kappa,\\
                \langle R(\pi/2) \overline{M_2} \widetilde{Q}_2, \overline{M_2} \widetilde{Q}_{3}\rangle > 2 \varepsilon(\sqrt{2} + \varepsilon) + 6\kappa,\\
                \langle R(\pi/2) \overline{M_2} \widetilde{Q}_3, \overline{M_2} \widetilde{Q}_{1}\rangle > 2 \varepsilon(\sqrt{2} + \varepsilon) + 6\kappa.
        \end{align*}
    \item Set $r = r'/1000 \in \mathbb{Q}$ with $r'$ taken from the r column and define
        \[
            \delta = \max_{i=1,2,3}\left\|R_{\mathbb{Q}}(\overline{\alpha}) \overline{M_1} \widetilde{P}_i-\overline{M_2} \widetilde{Q}_i\right\|_{+}/2 + 3\kappa \in \mathbb{Q}.
        \]
    \item Check that $\| \overline{M_2} \widetilde{Q}_i \|_{-} > r + \sqrt{2} \varepsilon + 3\kappa$ for $i=1,2,3$.
    \item Finally verify that 
    \[
        \frac{\langle \overline{M_2} \widetilde{Q}_i,\overline{M_2} (\widetilde{Q}_i-\widetilde{Q}_j)\rangle - 10\kappa - 2 \varepsilon ( \|\widetilde{Q}_i-\widetilde{Q}_j\|_{+} + 2 \kappa ) \cdot  (\sqrt{2}+\varepsilon)}{ \big(\|\overline{M_2} \widetilde{Q}_i\|_{+}+\sqrt{2} \varepsilon + 3\kappa \big) \cdot \big(\|\overline{M_2}(\widetilde{Q}_i-\widetilde{Q}_j)\|_{+}+2 \sqrt{2} \varepsilon + 6 \kappa\big)} > \frac{\sqrt{5} \varepsilon + \delta}{r},
    \]
    for all $i = 1,2,3$ and any $\widetilde{Q}_j \in \widetilde{\mathbf{NOP}} \setminus \widetilde{Q}_i$.
\end{enumerate}

Note that $\sqrt{2}$ in the steps 5., 6., 8. and 9. can be approximated by $142/100 = 1.42 > \sqrt{2}$ making the inequalities stricter and the expressions rational. Similarly, we approximate $\sqrt{5}$ in step 9. by $224/100 = 2.24 > \sqrt{5}$, so that also this condition becomes a statement on purely rational numbers. It follows that the only non-rational condition to check is step 3., namely that 
\(
P^tP = Q^tQ
\)
for $P = (P_1|P_2|P_3) \in \overline{\mathbb{Q}}^{3 \times 3}$, $Q = (Q_1|Q_2|Q_3)\in \overline{\mathbb{Q}}^{3 \times 3}$ and that $\det(Q) \neq 0$. Note that these expressions are, however, over algebraic numbers and \href{https://www.sagemath.org/}{SageMath} can prove them relatively~quickly.
nodes.statement_short: Run the local-leaf verification procedure; only the congruence check is over algebraic numbers.

nodes.name: Run time and conclusion
nodes.statement:
We implemented the verification of the solution tree integrity as well as the procedures of \cref{sec:veriglob} and \cref{sec:veriloc} in \href{https://www.sagemath.org/}{SageMath}. The total run time of this code is roughly 30h on a good PC which roughly consists of 1h for the solution tree integrity check, 16h of verification of rational global theorems and 10h of rational local theorems verification. 
This finally finishes the proof of \cref{thm:main}.
nodes.statement_short: The SageMath run (about 30h) completes the proof.
